text:
## Template 14: Fraud Claim Resolved  
**Trigger:** Disputed transaction investigated and resolved  
```
FirstUK: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.
Refund of £[amount] processed. See email for full details.
Call 0800-555-2265 with questions.
```  
*Character count: ~150*

name: Chunk 16/24

raw_entities.name: Fraud Claim Resolved
raw_entities.description: SMS notification template sent to customer when a disputed transaction claim has been investigated and resolved. Includes dispute reference number, refund amount, and customer service contact details. Designed to confirm resolution and direct customer to email for full details.
context: Trigger: Disputed transaction investigated and resolved
FirstUK: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved. Refund of £[amount] processed. See email for full details.

raw_entities.name: Dispute Reference Number
raw_entities.description: Unique identifier for the disputed transaction claim, formatted as EXC-XXXXX. Used to allow customer to reference their specific dispute in follow-up communications.
context: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.

raw_entities.name: Refund Amount
raw_entities.description: The monetary value of the refund processed to the customer's account as a result of the resolved dispute claim. Expressed in pounds sterling.

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction Investigation and Resolution
raw_entities.description: The process of investigating a customer's disputed transaction claim and communicating the resolution outcome. Triggers the Fraud Claim Resolved SMS template when investigation is complete and a refund decision has been made.
context: Trigger: Disputed transaction investigated and resolved
